reason: The plugin is primarily a communication gateway: it lets users control and converse with DeepSeek Harness agents from Feishu/Lark chat and returns status/replies there. Evidence in the repository description, README features, and package metadata consistently shows IM-to-agent bridging with session handling and file/tool command relay, matching the external-services category.

summaries.zh: 这是一款轻量的飞书/Lark 网关插件，让你在群聊或私信中通过消息与本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体互动，按会话处理任务并将结果回传到同一对话。
summaries.en: This is a lightweight Lark/Feishu gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets users drive a local agent from chat messages and commands, preserving conversational session context while returning execution updates and outputs back in the same IM thread.

capabilities: message-based gateway to trigger agent sessions
bridges approvals and command responses between Feishu/Lark and dsh
delivers files from workspace back to chat

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness where users chat with the bot in DM or @mention to drive the agent and receive replies in the same conversation.
README documents environment-based configuration with DSH_LARK_APP_ID and DSH_LARK_APP_SECRET and long-connection WebSocket messaging to Feishu/Lark.
README describes a built-in lark_deliver tool that sends workspace files/images back to chat with checks limited to the working directory.
package.json declares the plugin as dsh-plugin and includes lark-related/deepseek dependencies and peer integration points, confirming external service orchestration.
